places.name: Tabin Wildlife Reserve (Taman Hidupan Liar)
places.notes: iNat place_type=100 (open space/park), admin_level none. Bbox returned by /v1/places/autocomplete; polygon geometry not downloaded/inspected, but the place filter works (2161 obs total). Bbox is ~37 km N-S x 55 km E-W, larger than the ~1,225 km2 reserve (includes surroundings/Darvel Bay). Prefer place_id over bbox. A second smaller place exists: 194853 Tabin Virgin Jungle Reserve (bbox 5.1931,118.5037 to 5.2168,118.6731) which contains the resort/Lipad area.

places.name: Danum Valley Conservation Area (Kawasan Pemuliharaan)
places.notes: iNat place_type=100, bbox returned; place filter works (5284 research-grade obs, all taxa). Bbox ~27 x 26 km; Danum CA is 438 km2 (Wikipedia). IMPORTANT: place-filtered counts EXCLUDE taxon-obscured observations (CR/EN/some VU taxa e.g. orangutan, elephant, bearded pig), so place totals of 0 for those taxa do not mean absent.

A private quote with separate lines for private nature guide per day, private vehicle 0800-1700 per day, private return transfer pp and private night safari pp duplicates these IF added on top of a package; if the quote REPLACES the package (room/meals only + private extras) it is not duplication. Needs the quote's exact basis.

inaturalist_api.rate: Official API Recommended Practices page returned 403 (Cloudflare) to fetch tools - exact limits UNVERIFIED from the official page. Secondary: pyinaturalist docs say they throttle to iNat's recommended rates (https://pyinaturalist.readthedocs.io/en/stable/user_guide/advanced.html); dronefly bot codes to <=60 req/min; forum report of 429s at 60/min on one endpoint (https://forum.inaturalist.org/t/429-error-from-observations-histogram-api-when-calling-at-60-calls-minute/64709). Safe design: <=1 req/s, cache results, descriptive User-Agent (my ~300 calls at ~1 per 1.1 s had no errors). The 10k/day figure is NOT confirmed.
inaturalist_api.photo_licensing: Taxon default_photo.license_code observed: cc-by, cc-by-nc, cc-by-nc-sa, cc-by-nc-nd, cc-by-sa, or null (all rights reserved) (see species[].default_photo_license). Show photographer attribution and license; NC licenses forbid commercial use; null means do not reuse without permission - prefer link-out or only CC-licensed photos. Based on the API field; formal iNat licensing text not fetched.
inaturalist_api.obscured_coordinates: VERIFIED: threatened taxa (e.g. Pongo pygmaeus, Sus barbatus) have obscured=true observations; place_id filter excludes them, bbox filter returns randomly displaced points. Do not present iNat counts as proof of presence/absence for those species.
